card.name: Libertarian think-tank and Reason bylines
card.fires_on: Small words ("'s", "at", "the", "from") right after a libertarian outlet or institute name, such as Reason, Acton Institute, American Enterprise Institute or Prometheus Books. Also in citations of free-market works.

modes.label: After think-tank or magazine name
modes.description: Linking word just before or after a libertarian publication or institute in an author bio.
modes.example: Ronald Bailey is Reason magazine<<'s>> science correspondent.

modes.label: Citation of political economy works
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or "The" in publisher details of classic liberty-themed books and papers.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like liberty, Liberty and libertarian.
card.plain: It fires in libertarian-leaning essays and bios, anticipating words about liberty.
